description.fun: Carbink is born from the heat and pressure deep underground, then sleeps there for millions of years, polishing other Carbink's gems with its fluffy collar. Its jewels catch people's eye and Sableye like to eat it, so it defends itself with beams fired from its gems. Very rarely, a Carbink mutates into the Mythical Diancie, said to rule packs of Carbink in hidden jewelled kingdoms.
description.guide: Carbink is a Rock- and Fairy-type Pokémon from Kalos, a small stone body set with blue crystals, born from heat and pressure underground. It fires energy beams from its gems to defend itself. In rare cases a Carbink mutates into the Mythical Pokémon Diancie.
description.tagline: A gem-studded rock that slept for millions of years
